name: Brandon Moreno
summary: The former flyweight champion from Mexico (24-12, age 32). Since 2025 he has lost to Tatsuro Taira (R2 TKO) and Lone'er Kavanagh (five-round decision), then won a split decision over Joseph Morales at Noche UFC in September.

how_they_fight.Striking: Busy boxer with good head movement; six knockouts, three of them in R3.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Strong: eleven submissions, seven of them in R1, mostly from the back.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped once since 2018 (Taira, R2). Many of his losses are decisions (seven, plus two split five-rounders).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Built for five rounds; often slow to start and stronger late.

patterns: Close decisions; stronger as the fight goes on
Late stoppages (R3 knockouts of Kara-France and Figueiredo)
concerns: Two losses in his last three; a split win over Morales
keys_to_beat: Win early rounds with volume; deny his back takes

news.text: Booked against Charles Johnson at UFC 335.
